directionContract.thesis: A personal page that makes the author's real work, skills, and credentials legible in seconds — not a template dashboard, not a portfolio of placeholders.
directionContract.ownWorld: Clean, modern, confident: near-white canvas, near-black ink, one indigo/violet accent, Inter as both display and body, generous whitespace, flattened depth, and a single authored entrance that shows up instead of many scattered effects.
directionContract.story: What the visitor understands: Dali Muñoz Moreno is a practical full-stack developer whose work is readable at a glance. Recruiters land on a CV, scan real projects, and find the contact.
directionContract.firstViewport: Display-led hero: large, confident heading; one job-like subtext; one primary call-to-action. Nothing above the fold competes with the author's name.
